source: Canonical MOD_METADATA.json files in the public intellistream StateAxis topic repositories

components.name: StateAxis ACL Graph Dispatcher
components.summary_en: Identity-bound ACL Graph capability dispatch for admitted Qwen2 decode shapes. Historical matched evidence found no material benefit; the active revision remains performance-unqualified.
components.summary_zh: 面向已准入 Qwen2 Decode shape 的身份绑定 ACL Graph 能力分派。历史配对证据未发现实质收益，当前版本仍未取得性能资格。
components.public_effect_en: Qwen2.5-14B BF16 B1-B32 matched 3+3 runs were exact and lifecycle-clean. Median request throughput changed -0.324%, TPOT P50 changed +2.043%, and peak HBM increased 6 MiB; the paired throughput interval crossed zero, so no material benefit is claimed.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen2.5-14B BF16、B1-B32 的 3+3 配对运行均通过精确性与生命周期检查。请求吞吐中位数变化 -0.324%，TPOT P50 变化 +2.043%，峰值 HBM 增加 6 MiB；配对吞吐区间跨过零点，因此不声明实质收益。

components.name: StateAxis Chunked Prefill
components.summary_en: Token-budgeted chunked prefill for mixed long-prefill and decode contention. The observed trade-off is workload-scoped and remains experimental.
components.summary_zh: 针对长 Prefill 与 Decode 混合竞争的 token-budget 分块 Prefill。已观察到的取舍仅适用于特定负载，仍属实验性。
components.public_effect_en: On Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2 with 32 AgentX agent-research requests at 1 RPS, the 256-token candidate improved mean TPOT by 3.46% but regressed mean TTFT by 53.75%. This tested cell is not performance-qualified.
components.public_effect_zh: 在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2、32 条 AgentX agent-research 请求、1 RPS 的单组测试中，256-token 候选使平均 TPOT 改善 3.46%，但平均 TTFT 退化 53.75%。该测试单元未取得性能资格。

components.name: StateAxis Device Metadata Delta
components.summary_en: Device-resident metadata deltas for stable decode state. Matched component measurements are positive, but online serving remains unqualified.
components.summary_zh: 面向稳定 Decode 状态的设备侧元数据增量。配对组件测量为正，但在线服务仍未取得资格。
components.public_effect_en: Exact two-device Ascend 910B2 component runs measured adaptive-candidate median speedups of 1.85x-1.92x across B1/B8/B32 for the admitted coalesced path. Row-sparse B8/B32 negatives are retained. This is metadata preparation plus synchronized H2D evidence, not online request throughput.
components.public_effect_zh: 两张 Ascend 910B2 上的精确组件测试显示，已准入 coalesced 路径在 B1/B8/B32 的 adaptive 候选中位加速为 1.85x-1.92x；row-sparse B8/B32 的负结果亦完整保留。这是元数据准备与同步 H2D 的组件证据，不是在线请求吞吐证据。

components.name: StateAxis Dynamic Microbatch
components.summary_en: Dynamic dual-microbatch overlap for greedy B16 decode. Fresh-process tested cells failed correctness, so no performance claim is admitted.
components.summary_zh: 面向 greedy B16 Decode 的动态双微批重叠。fresh-process 测试单元未通过正确性，因此不声明性能收益。
components.public_effect_en: Warm paths were exact, but repeated fresh-process cold paths produced token mismatches. The isolated throughput observation is rejected by the correctness gate and is not a performance result.
components.public_effect_zh: Warm 路径保持精确，但重复的 fresh-process 冷路径出现 token 不一致。孤立的吞吐观测被正确性门禁拒绝，不构成性能结果。

components.name: StateAxis Host-tier Residency
components.summary_en: Generation-safe host-tier offload and exact restore under device-slot pressure. The historical tested cell hit its negative stop rule.
components.summary_zh: 设备状态槽压力下的 generation-safe Host 层卸载与精确恢复。历史测试单元触发了负向停止规则。
components.public_effect_en: In the frozen Qwen2.5-14B component cell, host-tier-hit wall time regressed from 596.474 ms to 631.609 ms (+5.89%), pair makespan increased 24.675 ms, peak HBM increased 2 MiB, and measured device overlap was zero. The campaign stopped at 1+1.
components.public_effect_zh: 在冻结的 Qwen2.5-14B 组件单元中，host-tier-hit 墙钟时间由 596.474 ms 退化至 631.609 ms（+5.89%），配对 makespan 增加 24.675 ms，峰值 HBM 增加 2 MiB，设备重叠为零，因此实验在 1+1 后停止。

components.name: StateAxis Identity-bound INT8 KV
components.name_zh: StateAxis 身份绑定 INT8 KV
components.summary_en: Identity-bound INT8 KV storage exploration. Component bytes and timing were positive, but full-model accuracy failed.
components.summary_zh: 身份绑定的 INT8 KV 存储探索。组件字节量与耗时为正，但整模型精度未通过。
components.public_effect_en: Historical Qwen2.5-14B component evidence reduced KV bytes by about 50% and improved component P50 by 5.7574%, but exact greedy token parity failed for every tested full-model layer range. Online ON/OFF testing stopped at the accuracy gate.
components.public_effect_zh: 历史 Qwen2.5-14B 组件证据显示 KV 字节量约减少 50%，组件 P50 改善 5.7574%；但所有已测整模型层范围的精确 greedy token parity 均失败，因此在线 ON/OFF 在精度门禁处停止。

components.name: StateAxis Incremental Eviction
components.summary_en: Generation-safe bitmap eviction indexing. The narrow selector component is positive, while matched real-online results are mixed.
components.summary_zh: generation-safe bitmap 淘汰索引。窄范围 selector 组件为正，但真实在线配对结果混合。
components.public_effect_en: The bounded 17-state single-victim bitmap path improved component P50 by 65.12%. In a Qwen2.5-7B 64-request online churn workload, paired throughput deltas were -1.276%, +0.005%, and +3.257%; signs did not repeat, so no online gain is qualified.
components.public_effect_zh: 有界 17-state single-victim bitmap 路径使组件 P50 改善 65.12%。在 Qwen2.5-7B、64 请求在线 churn 负载中，三组配对吞吐变化为 -1.276%、+0.005%、+3.257%；方向不能重复，因此不授予在线收益资格。

components.name: StateAxis Launch Fusion
components.summary_en: Identity-bound physical-B32 full-MLP launch fusion. Historical component timing is inconclusive; current online testing is reproducibly blocked.
components.summary_zh: 身份绑定的 physical-B32 全 MLP launch 融合。历史组件计时结论不确定；当前在线测试存在可复现阻塞。
components.public_effect_en: The exact component candidate improved device-event time 14.213% and host total time 16.939%, but 4.727% control drift failed the 2% gate. A current online run was not started because no fresh sealed full-MLP artifact was bound to the active Host/MOD identity; no online gain is claimed.
components.public_effect_zh: 精确组件候选的 device-event 时间改善 14.213%，Host 总时间改善 16.939%，但 control drift 为 4.727%，未通过 2% 门禁。由于缺少绑定当前 Host/MOD 身份的新鲜密封 full-MLP 制品，本轮未启动在线测试，不声明在线收益。

components.name: StateAxis Length-aware Queue
components.summary_en: Length-tiered scheduling for varied-length cold-prefill queues. Historical matched evidence was neutral-to-negative.
components.summary_zh: 面向不同长度冷 Prefill 队列的长度分层调度。历史配对证据为中性至负向。
components.public_effect_en: Historical Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 runs were exact with 51 candidate authority applications per run. Mean throughput was 4.542923 control versus 4.511304 candidate (-0.6960%); the paired 95% interval crossed zero. The active revision remains unqualified.
components.public_effect_zh: 历史 Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 运行保持精确，每次候选运行应用 51 次 authority。平均吞吐为 control 4.542923、candidate 4.511304（-0.6960%），配对 95% 区间跨过零点；当前版本仍未取得资格。

components.name: StateAxis Multi-LoRA Residency
components.summary_en: Identity, isolation and bounded residency for heterogeneous LoRA batches. Correctness passed; the available performance pair was negative.
components.summary_zh: 异构 LoRA batch 的身份、隔离及有界驻留。正确性通过；现有性能配对为负。
components.public_effect_en: In one frozen Qwen2.5-14B real-NPU pair, candidate throughput was 31.150412 req/s versus 31.276969 control (-0.405%); P50/P95 latency changed +233.753%/+24.044% and peak HBM increased 64 MiB. Correctness passed, but one pair cannot qualify performance.
components.public_effect_zh: 在一组冻结的 Qwen2.5-14B 真实 NPU 配对中，candidate 吞吐为 31.150412 req/s，control 为 31.276969 req/s（-0.405%）；P50/P95 延迟变化 +233.753%/+24.044%，峰值 HBM 增加 64 MiB。正确性通过，但单组配对不能授予性能资格。

components.name: StateAxis On-device Sampling
components.summary_en: Device-side categorical sampling and bounded beam ranking. Historical fresh-process real-NPU evidence was negative.
components.summary_zh: 设备侧分类采样与有界 beam 排序。历史 fresh-process 真实 NPU 证据为负。
components.public_effect_en: The Qwen2.5-14B frozen three-pair cell passed exactness, but candidate request throughput regressed 14.654% and P95 latency increased 80.131%.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen2.5-14B 冻结三组配对单元通过精确性检查，但 candidate 请求吞吐退化 14.654%，P95 延迟增加 80.131%。

components.name: StateAxis One-step Scheduling
components.summary_en: Same-turn exact plan/forward authority for bounded state budgets. The tested cell was not beneficial.
components.summary_zh: 面向有界状态预算的同一 turn 精确 plan/forward 权限。已测单元没有收益。
components.public_effect_en: The historical Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 matched run measured 1.0047x median throughput with only two positive paired signs. Even an impossible all-gap-removal ceiling peaked at 2.9798%, below the preregistered 5% threshold.
components.public_effect_zh: 历史 Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 配对运行的吞吐中位数为 1.0047x，且仅两组配对方向为正。即使采用不可能实现的全 gap 消除上界，峰值也仅 2.9798%，低于预注册的 5% 门槛。

components.name: StateAxis Preemption Recompute
components.summary_en: Generation-safe preemption and deterministic recompute under state-slot pressure. The matched real-NPU cell violated the no-harm gate.
components.summary_zh: 状态槽压力下 generation-safe 抢占与确定性重算。真实 NPU 配对单元违反 no-harm 门禁。
components.public_effect_en: All Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 arms were exact and pressure TTFT improved, but long-sojourn latency regressed 113.375%, violating the 5% no-harm guard.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 的所有实验臂均保持精确，pressure TTFT 有所改善，但 long-sojourn 延迟退化 113.375%，违反 5% no-harm 门禁。

components.name: StateAxis Program-aware Scheduling
components.summary_en: Attained-service scheduling for generation-bound agent programs. Historical matched evidence failed its benefit and guard gates.
components.summary_zh: 面向 generation-bound Agent 程序的 attained-service 调度。历史配对证据未通过收益与保护门禁。
components.public_effect_en: Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 runs were exact. Program throughput improved 0.355%, completion P50 11.973%, and fairness 12.0%, but completion P95 improved only 0.378% and ordinary-request TPOT P99 regressed 8.082%, failing the 15% benefit and 5% guard gates.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 运行保持精确。Program 吞吐改善 0.355%，completion P50 改善 11.973%，fairness 改善 12.0%；但 completion P95 仅改善 0.378%，普通请求 TPOT P99 退化 8.082%，未通过 15% 收益与 5% 保护门禁。

components.name: StateAxis Session Lifecycle
components.summary_en: Session-aware state reuse and bounded holder lifetime. Recomputation evidence is positive, while serving performance remains mixed.
components.summary_zh: 会话感知状态复用与有界 holder 生命周期。重计算证据为正，但服务性能仍为混合结果。
components.public_effect_en: Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 runs reduced recomputed prompt tokens from 12 to 0 and raised protected-root hits from 0 to 3. Logical throughput improved 0.506% and TPOT P99 improved 5.53%, while TTFT P99 regressed 1.76%; the component predicate passed but serving performance is mixed.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen2.5-14B 3+3 运行将重计算 prompt token 从 12 降至 0，protected-root hit 从 0 增至 3。逻辑吞吐改善 0.506%，TPOT P99 改善 5.53%，但 TTFT P99 退化 1.76%；组件谓词通过，服务性能仍为混合结果。

components.name: StateAxis Shared-prefix Attention
components.summary_en: Fork-cohort attention for sibling decode generations sharing an exact prefix. Historical component gates were not met.
components.summary_zh: 面向共享精确前缀的 sibling Decode generation 的 fork-cohort attention。历史组件门禁未通过。
components.public_effect_en: One component revision improved P50 by 31.185% but failed correctness. A later revision improved P50 by 9.828%-14.063%, but its matched timing run also failed correctness and every endpoint missed the preregistered 20% crossover gate.
components.public_effect_zh: 一个组件版本使 P50 改善 31.185%，但正确性失败；后续版本使 P50 改善 9.828%-14.063%，其配对计时运行仍未通过正确性，且所有端点均未达到预注册的 20% crossover 门槛。

components.name: StateAxis Sleep / Wake
components.summary_en: Idle-only whole-worker resource release and exact wake reassembly. Resource release is validated; this is not inference speedup.
components.summary_zh: 仅空闲时执行的整 worker 资源释放与精确唤醒重组。资源释放已验证；这不是推理加速。
components.public_effect_en: Historical Qwen2.5-14B evidence reclaimed 51,653 MiB while idle; measured wake P95 was 35.892 seconds. The mechanism remains default-off and this result is a resource-release measurement, not a throughput gain.
components.public_effect_zh: 历史 Qwen2.5-14B 证据在空闲时释放 51,653 MiB，实测唤醒 P95 为 35.892 秒。该机制保持默认关闭；这是资源释放测量，不是吞吐收益。

components.name: StateAxis Speculative Decoding
components.summary_en: Physical-B32 target verification for draft widths K1-K8. The component is positive, but the online upper bound is negative.
components.summary_zh: 面向 draft width K1-K8 的 physical-B32 target verification。组件为正，但在线上界为负。
components.public_effect_en: Qwen2.5-14B target verification was exact and 1.547x-4.112x faster as a component, but the frozen prompt-lookup candidate's optimistic serial upper bound was only 1.016x-1.019x. No online gain is claimed.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen2.5-14B target verification 保持精确，组件速度提升 1.547x-4.112x；但冻结 prompt-lookup 候选的乐观串行上界仅 1.016x-1.019x，因此不声明在线收益。

components.name: StateAxis Typed Hybrid State Groups
components.name_zh: StateAxis 类型化混合状态组
components.summary_en: Transactional lifecycle for typed recurrent and full-KV state groups. Current online qualification is blocked by unavailable TP4 devices and runtime identity.
components.summary_zh: 类型化 recurrent 与 full-KV 状态组的事务化生命周期。当前在线资格因 TP4 设备与运行时身份不可用而阻塞。
components.public_effect_en: The ECPA/Host contract and real-worker probe path pass in software. HyStateBench 1.2 Qwen3.8-27B BF16 TP4 could not run because the container exposed only two devices and no immutable-image launcher or current owned-runtime binding. No performance number is inferred.
components.public_effect_zh: ECPA/Host 合同与真实 worker probe 路径已通过软件验证。HyStateBench 1.2 Qwen3.8-27B BF16 TP4 因容器仅暴露两张设备，且缺少不可变镜像启动器与当前 owned-runtime 绑定而未运行；不推断任何性能数字。

components.name: StateAxis Workflow-disaggregated Residency
components.summary_en: Workflow-scoped request residency and recovery. Local recovery is validated; current online testing is blocked by the absent remote data plane.
components.summary_zh: 以 workflow 为作用域的请求驻留与恢复。本地恢复已验证；当前在线测试因缺少远端数据面而阻塞。
components.public_effect_en: Matched runtime and managed assembly checks passed, but peer transfer and remote allocation remain disabled. No cross-instance or performance benefit is claimed until a remote data plane exists.
components.public_effect_zh: 配对 runtime 与 managed assembly 检查均通过，但 peer transfer 与 remote allocation 仍被禁用。在远端数据面可用前，不声明跨实例或性能收益。
